note: v3183: His ruling that a Latent or Renewed charm is its own entity in the vault while the chronicle counts it once, built as one module with a measured rule: a qualifier is identity and never folds, while an apostrophe byte, a base-type tail and an unambiguous parenthetical are rendering and do fold. Three rows he owns had 159 banked sightings that no lookup could reach. Crescent Moon keeps its suffix because the bare name is also a runeword.
